verdicts.reason: A is unusable: the can has shrunk to a tiny speck beside the CTA, the circle has been pulled off the can into the bottom-left, the badges are scattered far apart at the top and bottom, the CTA is tiny, and the middle of the canvas is dead space. B at least keeps the product can at a usable size, but it has the same detached circle; its CTA and badges are crammed into tiny pills on top of that circle, so the CTA is buried; and SOLSTICE sits below the headline, so the reading order is wrong.
